text: Every way one free alphabet and a repeating key fit the 20 official letters but not the 24 (0274), each with its own known letters.
0253's: one climb for K4, then copies that fit the same way, climbed one at a time until one reads as well, at most 12, then 100.
K4 beats all 12 in 6 of 49 settings, chance 3.8; all 100 in two, chance 0.5. Their readings are not English (CDKLDCBCBETHB..., XTWAILFLONYS...).
The two settings above 100 copies are replicated on fresh copies (F16.1a-r2) before the queue goes on.
